messages.text: Yes — the one you're currently viewing, the 12-inch Explorer Blue Ocean Desk Globe with Raised Relief, is the English-language edition. If you'd rather have French labels, there's also the Explorer 12" Blue Ocean Desk Globe (French Edition), same price and raised-relief map, just with French place names. Want me to point you to that one instead?
Any discount for the English version?

I don't see any discount or promo listed for the English Explorer 12" Blue Ocean Desk Globe — it's $116.00 CAD as shown on the page. If you spend $99 or more, shipping is free across Canada, which the discounted price doesn't need to hit since it's already close! If you think there's a specific promo code you have, let me know and I can check.
It’s shown talk with you can get 20 off

That 20% off reward is linked to the separate "Talk with Mia" voice interview banner on the site — completing that conversation earns you a reward code you can then enter at checkout. It's not something I can apply directly here in this chat. If you've already done that interview and have a code, just enter it at checkout and it'll apply to the Explorer globe.
